title: Shared definitions for vosu 2.0 state namespaces
description: Not a namespace on its own; every other schema in this directory $refs these $defs by relative path. Loading this file alone is a syntax check only — $ref targets are not resolved across files.

semver.description: A semantic version, as carried by capability requirements in the catalog (docs/v2/catalog-v2.md).

pluginId.description: Dot-separated namespace/plugin id grammar from the shared naming contract: 2-4 segments, each [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}.

resourceRef.description: A reference to one file resource (ADR 0021). Core mints `url`; it never embeds a filesystem path.

url.description: `/api/v1/resources/{id}`, an opaque HMAC-derived id. Stable across restarts while the reference stays published.

type.description: MIME type from the resource-route allowlist (image/audio/video/chart-text), or `application/octet-stream`.

treeRef.description: A reference to an indexed folder resource (ADR 0021): a chart set folder or the current skin.

url.description: `/api/v1/trees/{id}/`. `GET` lists the index; `GET`/`HEAD /api/v1/trees/{id}/{path}` resolves one entry.

judgement.description: One entry of a game-declared judgement breakdown (ADR 0020). The list itself is ordered best to miss by `ordinal`.

id.description: Stable identifier the game plugin assigns this judgement, e.g. `great`. Never reused for a different meaning within one namespace major version.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the judgement, e.g. `300` or `Great`, as the game itself names it.

ordinal.description: 0 is the best judgement; larger values are progressively worse, with miss the highest ordinal the game declares.

count.description: Judgements of this kind in the current attempt. `null` only if the plugin cannot fill this entry at all; an attempt with zero hits of this kind is `0`, never `null`.

samplingLane.description: Per-field sampling lane metadata (ADR 0020 Publication). Core's subscription compiler unions the lanes of every selected field to compute reader demand, as 1.x's V2SubscriptionHub/plan compiler (src/server/v2_subscription.rs) does for its fixed field set. A property with no `x-sampling-lane` annotation needs no extra demand: it is covered by the plugin's configured base polling at every state.

lane.description: Which reader a subscription to this field wakes: the plugin's regular-cadence reader, its high-frequency precise reader, or both (a value derived from both, such as unstable rate).

activity.description: `always`: the lane runs at its demand-driven rate regardless of game status. `gameplay`: demand applies only while the session's `vosu.status.status` is `play` (including replay/spectate/autoplay sources); outside play the field is still published, at the lane's configured idle cadence.
